description: Compact account-anchored readiness doorbell registered through sync_accounts notification_configs using reporting.delivery_ready. Managed-delivery tier only: it names a materialization at a destination, so Core (API-delivered) configurations never fire it — Core consumers subscribe to reporting.status_changed and poll get_reporting_status. The named revision/materialization MUST already be observable through the intended consumer path. Transport retries are deduplicated by (authenticated sender, idempotency_key); downstream ingestion is deduplicated independently by reporting_revision_id and reporting_materialization_id. Ordering is unconstrained and receivers repair through authenticated get_reporting_status. The event MUST be signed using the advertised AdCP webhook-signing profile and MUST NOT contain rows, object lists, signed URLs, activation URLs, credentials, or access tokens.

feed_purpose.description: Operational use of an independently scheduled and reconciled feed. pacing is the fast snapshot path; billing requires official revisions and consumer reconciliation. Event-level exposure is intentionally deferred until a privacy and authorization contract exists.
feed_purpose.title: Reporting Feed Purpose

finality.description: Finality of a reporting revision. Snapshot revisions are provisional and may be superseded. An official revision is the immutable, invoice-addressable close for its reporting slice and MUST NOT be superseded; later source corrections are explicit reporting adjustments rather than silent replacement revisions.

enumDescriptions.official: Immutable seller-authoritative close for the represented period. Buyers may key invoices and settlement records to its reporting_revision_id. Later corrections are explicit adjustments, never superseding revisions.
enumDescriptions.snapshot: Provisional seller/source reporting evidence; not sufficient by itself for billing.

finality.title: Reporting Finality

idempotency_key.description: Stable across transport retries of this fire; new for a later re-emission.

notification_id.description: Stable for this logical materialization-ready event across re-emissions.

title: Reporting Delivery Ready Webhook

x-adcp-validation.authorization: The authenticated webhook signer, subscriber_id, account_id, configuration generation, revision, and materialization MUST belong to one caller/account binding; receivers MUST repair through an authenticated status read rather than trusting event contents alone.
x-adcp-validation.deduplication: Deduplicate transport retries by (authenticated sender, idempotency_key), then deduplicate ingestion independently by reporting_revision_id and reporting_materialization_id.
